title: Agent state per pane from Claude Code hooks, answered from the manager list
notes: A hook script posts permission_prompt, idle_prompt, agent_needs_input and agent_completed to the app. Main keeps a state per pane, keyed by an environment variable the app sets at spawn. The manager row shows the state and the question text; a key on the row sends the answer to that pane. Bell detection stays as the fallback for shells that are not Claude Code.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: much of this may exist already. workerSettings (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts) installs Notification (permission_prompt to 'blocked'), UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse notify hooks, and #294 added stop notices with the last message and pane report. Check what is left first: the manager row showing the state and question text, and a key answering from the row. Build only that, following keyboard-first and the help rule. If nothing is left, say so on the card. Do not bump the version.

Hooks per pane, the asking row and bell fallback already existed. Built the gap: a Claude-screen worker's manager row printed its hidden shell and typed keys went there. Now the row shows the question with numbered answers and a digit answers it (main too). PR #302.
